# Fictional museum-exhibit exercise: source-review excerpts

## ME-02
The case requests sensor validity and risk assessments concurrently. Every returned
assessment identifies the case and alert. A protection recommendation requires
both a valid-sensor result and a risk-confirmed result for the same alert. If
either assessment is unavailable, the alert remains awaiting assessment.

## ME-04
Each assessor must acknowledge its request within 10 minutes after confirmed
delivery to that assessor. Queueing a notice does not start the interval. Without
delivery confirmation, the request remains pending delivery and the coordinator
investigates contact. An acknowledged request is not a completed assessment.
Missing acknowledgment at the deadline is escalated to the duty conservator; it
does not manufacture an assessment result.

## ME-05
The conservator must reassess the exhibit and record risk cleared before the
coordinator closes it.

## REVISION
This focused fixture has one source revision. A separate revision exercise must
check changed authority and requirements while preserving unaffected recipe IDs.
